Title: Designer — Section reorder via drag and drop
Preconditions: Page has at least 3 sections in the designer
Steps:
[ACT] [MANUAL] Not reliably automatable with the current MCP browser toolset: this reorder uses Angular CDK Drag & Drop (@angular/cdk/drag-drop), pointer-events-based (no HTML5 draggable=true anywhere). The drag must originate on a dedicated 24x24 app-drag-handle grip that only appears on row hover, and that handle carries no accessible role/name — it gets no snapshot uid, so uid-based MCP drag/click/hover tools (Chrome DevTools MCP) cannot target it at all. Even a coordinate-capable driver would need a real multi-step pointer sequence (mousedown -> incremental mousemove -> mouseup) on that handle, not a synthetic HTML5 dragstart/drop dispatch. Confirmed live 2026-07-21: a row-body drag only selects the row; Save stays disabled (no reorder committed). The steps below remain the manual execution procedure.
[NAV] Open a page with multiple sections in the designer
[ACT] Identify the order of sections in the left panel
[ACT] Drag the first section below the second section (grab the drag-handle grip that appears on hover, not the row body)
[ASSERT] Verify the sections reorder in the left panel
[ASSERT] Verify the live preview updates to reflect the new section order
[ACT] Save the page
[ACT] Reopen the page and verify the order is persisted
Assertions: Sections can be dragged to reorder; left panel reflects new order immediately; preview updates; order persists after save and reload
Failure_Signals: Drag not working; order reverting on save; preview not reflecting reorder
